actions.AI_RUN: AI run on the changed page

outputs.COMMENT: As a comment on the page

scheduleFields.atHint: Runs exactly once. After that, the rule remains in place without turning itself off.
scheduleFields.dayOfMonthHint: The 31st means the last day in a shorter month. A month is never skipped.
scheduleFields.cronHint: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week (0 is Sunday). Ranges, lists, and steps are allowed; names and aliases like @daily are not.
scheduleFields.zoneHint: Belongs to the rule, not to the server. Daylight saving time is accounted for: 07:00 stays 07:00.

dialog.description: When something changes within the selected scope or the schedule is due, the action runs. An automation never overwrites the content of a page.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.namePlaceholder: Notify Hermes about new meeting notes
dialog.debounceHint: How long a page must remain quiet before the rule runs. Without this, every keystroke triggers a run, and with an AI run, each of them costs money.
dialog.secretIntro: The rule has been created. You can see the signing secret now and never again: eXocortex cannot retrieve it. The receiving service needs it to verify the signature.
dialog.secretSignature: Every POST includes the headers {timestampHeader} and {signatureHeader}. {signedValue} is signed via HMAC-SHA256 with this secret.
dialog.scopeDocumentHint: The ID is in the address bar of the page.
dialog.triggersHint: Row values only exist within the scope of a database, everything else only outside. A schedule stands alone and requires a page as its scope: the clock specifies none.
dialog.mailSubjectPlaceholder: Leave blank for the name of the rule
dialog.mailHint: The email goes to the verified address of your own account, nowhere else. The text contains the page itself, shortened for long pages and with a link below.
dialog.webhookNoHosts: This installation currently does not allow any webhook targets. A global administrator must configure {setting}.
dialog.webhookHosts: Allowed hosts: {hosts}. Only metadata of the page is sent, never its content.
dialog.promptPlaceholder: Check whether this page contains outdated information due to the change.
dialog.promptHint: The modified page is the model’s material. The response ends up alongside it, not inside it.
dialog.modelPlaceholder: Leave empty for the default model

page.title: Automations
page.intro: Rules that react to page changes or the clock: a signed webhook or an AI run against the affected page.
page.disabled: Automations are turned off for this workspace. None of the rules below will run, regardless of how they are configured. You can toggle this via the setting {setting}; if the installation has turned them off globally, a workspace cannot turn them back on itself.
page.readOnly: Only the owner of this workspace can create and edit rules. A rule sends data externally or spends money on a model, and it keeps doing so even when nobody is watching.
page.emptyDescription: A rule consists of three answers: where it watches, what it reacts to, and what it does next.
